title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - New Survey Owner role provides access to survey results
description: When a new program is being set up in Glint, there is now an option to designate Survey Owners. Those added as Survey Owners will be able to view and manage certain aspects of the program, as well as see the results when a survey in the program closes.
